name: Rejuvenating Flames
text:
You create a gout of flame that both heals and burns. You restore @item.leveld4 healing HP to all allies in the area, and those allies gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves for 1 minute. Enemies in the area take 1d4 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

Spell Effect: Rejuvenating Flames

---
Heightened (+1) You restore an additional 1d4 HP to your allies and deal an additional 1d4 fire damage to enemies.
